<!-- Features and behaviour changes need an issue where a maintainer agreed the direction. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

**Problem:** what was wrong or missing, and why it matters.

**Fix:** what this changes.

**Issue:** link the issue, or say why this focused fix needs none.

**Checked:** `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` pass, and a test covers the change.
